name: Entropy Crusade
caption: Dirge and Brimstone's own tag pairing through Mercury's opening months, before EEI absorbed the name.

name: EEI
caption: A self-declared corporation and stable built around Dirge, Brimstone, Vincent Picasso and Johnny Glamour, which absorbed Pariah for one card in April 2002, and held the LCW Mercury Tag Team Championship through three reshufflings among its own members between February and April 2002.

tenures.source: the federation's own served show documents and roleplay board (promotions/lcw-mercury/)

name: The Elite
caption: Vincent Picasso and Johnny Glamour's own tag pairing, the incarnation of EEI's tag title reign running from February 2002 through Suicide.

identity.note: Shares the generic tag-team name The Elite with units in the unrelated PWE Inc. and GLW promotions; a shared generic team name across unconnected federations is never a merge on its own.

tenures.role: tag team — Mercury Tag Team Champions
